_what: Every narration sentence maps to a span of script/essay.txt, the sources of record for this film.
thesis: Circulation made the marks and the collectors named them; the Sets are structures the Trait Council identified in what was named, and each one redefines a single Cent as the piece some collection completes or lacks, a valuation that goes on being made as Cents change hands.
script_target: target ~100 s; 194 words measures 105 s at 1.84 w/s (rate measured on the user's recordings)
epoch_convention: See essay block [7]. CATALOGUE = Sep 2026 export measured 2026-10-24; HOLDERS = 9 Sep 2026 snapshot, said with its date; SETS = cents.vision/sets.html.

claims.say: Rutherford Chang photographed each of ten thousand copper cents, to record its wear and patina.
claims.span: Chang photographed each coin to record its particular wear and patina
claims.epoch_note: Opens on the work and Chang's act, in the past tense. Says nothing about traits or Sets, so it gives him no motive for them.

claims.why: The framing the user approved for the bot: 'Circulation made the marks; the Trait Council named them.' Not in the written sources of record.

claims.say: The names came afterwards, from the collectors, over two years of voting.
claims.span: a community-led initiative carried out over the course of 2 years through multiple reviews of the full 10k set, numerous voting rounds
claims.epoch_note: User-approved wording; replaces 'nobody assigned the traits'.

claims.say: Out of the names, the Trait Council identified the Sets.
claims.span: emergent structures identified within the collection's internal dynamics

claims.say: Verdigris, obsidian, desert, red: one of each makes a Patina Set.
claims.span: at least one **Notable+** of each of the 4 base patinas
claims.epoch_note: 'One of each' simplifies Notable+; the on-screen requirement card gives the threshold.

claims.say: One full of each makes the Fulls, and only fifteen are full verdigris.
claims.epoch_note: A Council count; it can move if an adjudication is revised.

claims.say: Add a full gold, one of nine, and an orange, for the Full Spectrum.
claims.span: one **Full** of all 4 base patinas *plus* Full Gold and Orange
claims.epoch_note: Nine from block [5]: 'Exactly 9 Cents are full gold.'

claims.say: Full Contamination needs all twelve kinds, and scotch tape is on just seven Cents.
claims.epoch_note: Requirement from block [4]: covers all 12. There is no Corroded Set.

claims.span: holds at least one Cent minted in **each of 1971, 1979 and 1982**
claims.epoch_note: The film does not say why these years. Their meanings (fiat, Chang's birth, last copper) would risk reading as the Council's or Chang's intent.

claims.say: An S, a D and no mint mark make the Full Mint, and only sixty carry the S.
claims.span: Mint marks: no mark 8,343, D 1,597, S 60

claims.say: A Decades Set needs every year of the decade that the collection holds.
claims.span: hold at least one Cent from **every mint year of that decade present in the collection**

claims.say: Only one Cent is dated 1949, and only one 1954.
claims.span: 1949 has exactly one Cent. 1954 has exactly one Cent

claims.say: So the 1940s Set and the 1950s Set can each be held by one collector at a time.
claims.span: so each can be held by at most one collector at a time
claims.epoch_note: Derived in block [5] from the requirement and the two counts.

claims.say: Full Decades needs both, and on 9 September 2026 no one held it.
claims.epoch_note: MUST be re-read before recording. If someone holds it by then, the line changes to the new fact with its date.

claims.say: To the Treasury, each of these is worth a cent.
claims.span: a penny from any given year will always be worth exactly 1¢, according to the United States Treasury
claims.epoch_note: The value frame. 'Always' in the source supports the unqualified present.

claims.say: In the Sets, each is also the piece another collection is missing.
claims.why: The close. Interpretation in the value frame, ending on an open condition: Sets are completed and broken as Cents change hands. Not a price claim.
